title: Tech Note: Replication Administration Tool
author: Jesse Piña, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Stored procedures for remote server connections

historical_commentary.text: This note documents a component built to simplify configuring 4D v12's native database replication feature, wrapping it in a wizard so developers could set up data transfer between databases without hand-coding the replication mechanism. 4D's replication feature and the general concept of a configuration wizard remain valid, but 4D's data synchronization landscape has evolved substantially since 2012, with ORDA-based REST synchronization and 4D's later dedicated Sync feature offering more modern, entity-oriented approaches to moving data between servers and clients, making this specific classic-language RAT component and its wizard largely superseded for new projects, though the underlying replication feature it wraps may still exist for legacy use.
related_updates: 4D's ORDA-based data synchronization / Sync (introduced in later 4D versions) offers a more modern entity-oriented approach to replicating/synchronizing data between servers and clients
REST APIs built on ORDA (4D v16 R5/R6, 2017) are now commonly used for moving and syncing data between systems instead of classic database replication tooling
